external_entities.name: sensor node
external_entities.description: A deployed sensor device installed at a customer site.
external_entities.source_excerpt: We have a few thousand sensor nodes installed on customer sites.
external_entities.notes: The nodes are outside our physical control.

external_entities.name: field technician
external_entities.description: A technician who services sensor nodes using a local serial console.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.

external_entities.name: fleet operator
external_entities.description: An operator who views telemetry dashboards.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

processes.name: device gateway
processes.description: An MQTT broker that accepts sensor readings and forwards them to Pub/Sub.
processes.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway, which is an MQTT broker we run on GKE
processes.notes: Nodes authenticate to the broker with a per-fleet pre-shared key that has not been rotated since deployment.

processes.name: telemetry normalizer
processes.description: A Python consumer that picks up readings from Pub/Sub and writes them to the telemetry lake.
processes.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network, which writes them into the telemetry lake

data_stores.name: device registry
data_stores.description: A Firestore registry used to check device keys and identify the customer associated with a node.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_stores.name: Pub/Sub
data_stores.description: A messaging service receiving readings from the device gateway for pickup by the telemetry normalizer.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_stores.name: telemetry lake
data_stores.description: A BigQuery data store containing readings, site addresses, and occupancy patterns.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The lake has site addresses and occupancy patterns in it, so it is customer data.

data_stores.name: Cloud Storage bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket from which sensor nodes poll firmware images.
data_stores.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image and install what they find.
data_stores.notes: The bucket is public read. It is unknown whether nodes check a signature on an image before installing it.

data_flows.name: publish readings
data_flows.description: A sensor node publishes readings to the device gateway.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Each node publishes readings over MQTT to the device gateway

data_flows.name: look up device
data_flows.description: The device gateway looks up a device in the registry to check its key and customer association.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The gateway looks up the device in a device registry (Firestore) to check the key and to find out which customer the node belongs to.

data_flows.name: forward readings
data_flows.description: The device gateway forwards accepted readings onto Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Readings the gateway accepts are forwarded onto Pub/Sub

data_flows.name: pick up readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer picks up readings from Pub/Sub.
data_flows.source_excerpt: picked up by the telemetry normalizer

data_flows.name: write readings
data_flows.description: The telemetry normalizer writes readings into the telemetry lake.
data_flows.source_excerpt: which writes them into the telemetry lake in BigQuery.

data_flows.name: poll image
data_flows.description: A sensor node polls the Cloud Storage bucket for a firmware image.
data_flows.source_excerpt: nodes poll a Cloud Storage bucket for a new image
data_flows.notes: The bucket is public read. It is unknown whether the nodes check a signature on the image before installing it.

data_flows.name: service node
data_flows.description: A field technician services a sensor node over its local serial console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Field technicians service nodes over a local serial console.
data_flows.notes: I don't know what authentication that console has, if any.

data_flows.name: look at dashboards
data_flows.description: A fleet operator looks at dashboards using BigQuery from the corporate network.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our own fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network, signed in with company SSO.

trust_boundaries.name: customer site
trust_boundaries.description: A customer-controlled site where sensor nodes are installed.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: sensor nodes installed on customer sites

trust_boundaries.name: GKE
trust_boundaries.description: The GKE environment where the device gateway runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: an MQTT broker we run on GKE

trust_boundaries.name: analytics network
trust_boundaries.description: The network where the telemetry normalizer runs.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: the telemetry normalizer, a Python consumer in our analytics network

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which fleet operators access dashboards.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: fleet operators look at dashboards over BigQuery from the corporate network

assumptions.assumption: The device gateway holds credentials because it checks the device pre-shared key, and it handles customer-associated readings.
assumptions.basis: The gateway checks a pre-shared key and accepts readings associated with customer devices.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry contains credentials and personally identifying customer-associated information.
assumptions.basis: It stores or checks the device key and records which customer the node belongs to.

assumptions.assumption: The device registry is confidential.
assumptions.basis: It contains a pre-shared key and customer association information.

assumptions.assumption: The Pub/Sub store carries personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: The gateway forwards sensor readings to Pub/Sub, and the readings are associated with customer devices.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry normalizer handles personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: It picks up customer-associated readings and writes them to the telemetry lake.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake contains personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: The lake contains site addresses and occupancy patterns tied to customer telemetry.

assumptions.assumption: The telemetry lake is confidential.
assumptions.basis: The text states that it contains site addresses and occupancy patterns and calls this customer data.

assumptions.assumption: The Cloud Storage bucket holds business-critical data because it stores firmware images used by the deployed sensor fleet.
assumptions.basis: Sensor nodes poll it for firmware images and install those images.

assumptions.assumption: The sensor-reading flow carries personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: It carries readings from deployed customer-associated sensor nodes.

assumptions.assumption: The device-lookup flow carries credentials and customer-associated information.
assumptions.basis: The gateway looks up the device key and customer association.

assumptions.assumption: The gateway-to-Pub/Sub flow carries personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: It carries accepted sensor readings.

assumptions.assumption: The Pub/Sub-to-normalizer flow carries personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: It carries the customer-associated readings picked up by the normalizer.

assumptions.assumption: The normalizer-to-lake flow carries personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: It writes sensor readings into the lake containing site addresses and occupancy patterns.

assumptions.assumption: The firmware polling flow carries business-critical data.
assumptions.basis: It carries firmware images used to operate the sensor fleet.

assumptions.assumption: The dashboard-access flow carries personally identifying information.
assumptions.basis: The operators access dashboards over BigQuery containing customer telemetry data.
